suppress.notes: Expressly (Jakarta EL RI) is not GlassFish. The eclipse:glassfish CPE is a vendor-string collision; the associated GlassFish app-server CVEs are unreachable. Suppress the mis-assigned CPE, not the CVEs. Owner: uzaira0. Rechecked 2026-11-06: the runtime resolves expressly 6.0.0, still matched only through the eclipse:glassfish vendor string.

CVE-2026-53914 is a Kotlin build-cache-metadata deserialization flaw in the compiler/Gradle toolchain, not in the shipped kotlin-stdlib / kotlin-reflect runtime. Build-time only (JetBrains AV:L, 6.7 Medium). Owner: uzaira0 (backend and Android builds). Rechecked 2026-11-06: Kotlin 2.4.20 (2026-09-07) and 2.4.21 are stable and fixed; the build still pins 2.4.10 (gradles/chronicle.gradle, settings.gradle.kts), so the Kotlin upgrade is due and this suppression lapses on 2026-11-20. Rechecked 2026-11-06 (release blockers): GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp lists only org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin < 2.4.20-Beta1 as affected (CVSS 3.1 AV:L/AC:H/PR:H). kotlin-reflect is a runtime library with no build-cache code; it is on runtimeClasspath at 2.1.21 (chronicle-api, chronicle-models, rhizome-client) and 2.4.10 (chronicle-server, rhizome). cbc35f3d dropped it from this selector when pinning versions, which turned gradle-depcheck red on all five modules.

flyway-database-postgresql is Flyway's Java database adapter, not the PostgreSQL server. Its coincidental version 11.20.3 caused the postgresql:postgresql CPE to attach server CVEs to the adapter. Owner: uzaira0. Rechecked 2026-11-06: the runtime still resolves 11.20.3.

CVE-2026-42154 affects the Go Prometheus server's /api/v1/read endpoint. The io.prometheus:simpleclient Java metrics libraries neither implement nor expose that Prometheus server endpoint. Owner: uzaira0. Rechecked 2026-11-06: the runtime resolves simpleclient 0.16.0.

CVE-2022-40152 affects the Woodstox parser implementation before the patched releases. org.codehaus.woodstox:stax2-api is only the API contract; Chronicle resolves woodstox-core 7.2.0 separately. Owner: uzaira0. Rechecked 2026-11-06: the runtime resolves stax2-api 4.3.0.
